title: Signed total tensor comparison for normalized stalks
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe, J a Grothendieck topology, R a sheaf of commutative rings, p a point of Sh(C,J), and s a normalized ringed-site point [def-sfb-ringed-site-point], with stalk ring A and module functor S. For any unbounded cochain complexes F,K of R-modules, there is an isomorphism S(Tot(F tensor_R K)) ≅ Tot(S(F) tensor_A S(K)) of signed total complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0DEN; pointwise total tensor comparison

proof.text: Present ordinary sets and A-modules as sheaves and module sheaves on the bottom-topology singleton site. Use the ring and module operation graphs in s to give the point an algebraic inverse-image presentation. Its module adjunction gives preservation of colimits.

The inverse-image tensor comparison gives a natural comparison on module sheaves. Evaluation at the singleton is an equivalence compatible with tensor, by the sheafification unit and the explicit tensor map. This identifies the comparison with S(M tensor N) ≅ S(M) tensor S(N).

Apply mapBifunctorComparison to that natural comparison and the colimit-preserving functor S. Totalization uses coproducts, whose comparison is invertible. Its differential is the signed total differential, so this is an isomorphism of unbounded signed complexes, not merely a degreewise comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor (s : RingedSitePoint R p) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_independentCoefficients R
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj_independentCoefficients R
    ∀ F K : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ,
      Nonempty (((s.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor F K (curriedTensor _))) ≅
        CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
          ((s.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)
          ((s.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) (curriedTensor _))
